big: Out of every ₹100 the Indian economy produces, about ₹58 comes from households spending. That is why a cut in the price of daily goods matters to the whole economy, not just to your kitchen.

lines: Why does the news talk so much about GST cuts?
Private consumption is about 58% of GDP. The GST slabs were simplified in September 2025 into mainly 5% and 18%. Lower prices on daily goods lift spending, and spending lifts growth.
